title: Preliminary results of an intravitreal dexamethasone implant (Ozurdex®) in patients with persistent diabetic macular edema

license.statement: Dove Medical Press open access licence permitting unrestricted noncommercial use (article <license>); non-commercial, not CC BY, so private

condition: Persistent diabetic macular edema (BCVA 5-40 ETDRS letters, macular thickness of at least 275 um), Policlinico Umberto I, Rome; prospective single-arm case series of 20 eyes of 17 patients, 6-month follow-up; most patients had anti-VEGF in the 3 months before, others had contraindications to anti-VEGF

groups.agent: dexamethasone intravitreal implant 700 ug (Ozurdex), one implant; a second treatment cycle was recommended at month 4 for worsening (reinjection criteria)
groups.description: All treated eyes (20 eyes of 17 patients; in three patients the fellow eye was treated at a later stage); marketed implant, no experimental arm declared

series.baseline_label: Baseline before the implant (Table 2 row 2, Mean CMT column)
series.notes: Central macular thickness by Spectralis HRA-OCT (volumetric 512 x 49 scan), no subfield definition; mean ± SD (Results: results reported as means ± SD; Table 2 'Mean CMT'); day 3 converted as 3/30.4375 months; visits counted from the implant; per-visit n not reported; two eyes received a second treatment cycle under the month-4 reinjection criteria by month 6 and their values were not removed

exclusions.what: Untreated fellow (control) eyes reported in Results text
exclusions.reason: untreated fellow eyes are excluded; values given as central value with range, not tabulated

exclusions.what: Table 2 visual acuity (ETDRS letters) and logMAR columns

notes: Prior treatment mixed: 13 of 17 patients had anti-VEGF within 3 months before; Table 1 also lists previous PRP; some eyes had neither
Twenty eyes of 17 patients: in three patients the fellow eye was treated later and is counted among the treated eyes (each eye from its own implant)
P-values in the Results text are not extracted
